files.name: Meadow
files.prompt: Create a production albedo texture for an ORIGINAL stylized anime fantasy open world in Unity URP. Use-case: game terrain texture, not a landscape illustration. Single square 1024x1024 tile, orthographic straight-down flat scan filling every pixel, seamless repeat on all edges. Muted spring meadow turf: layered short grass blade brushwork, sage and olive greens, subtle warm straw strands. No tall individual clumps, no flowers. Hand-painted, restrained hue variation, readable medium-scale forms, softly brushed fine detail. Diffuse base color only, uniform neutral ambient illumination, no baked directional light, no cast shadows, no vignette, no border, no text, no graphic layout, no perspective, no horizon. Compatible with 3-band cel shaded characters, softly colored natural world. Keep surface details low-contrast so it tiles over a large terrain without a visible grid.
